purpose: Presentation scene with latest anchor plants and new full-background transport.
state_policy: Exact saved confirmed-target vector; no optimization for full background.

scanner_clearance.scope: All plant triangles versus the continuous receiver rectangle expanded by 10 mm in XYZ; geometric guard, not a measured moving-horn envelope. Static scanner and room collision checks are separate.

background: Metal reflections disabled; metal meshes retained for opaque visibility. Other background surfaces retained.
geometry_changes: Level support bench lowered to 0.50 m as an explicit geometry hypothesis, with unchanged RX phase-centre grid.
RIS backing board rotated with selected RIS aperture; stand remains fixed.
Old vegetation replaced by the exact close-pair anchor meshes.
solver_scope: Direct plus exhaustive finite one-reflection paths per hop; leaf/pot slab transmission on every leg; coherent RIS two-hop and bypass sum. Opaque room objects. No diffuse scattering or diffraction.
limitations: W01133 geometry is exploratory, not surveyed.
Archived room/absorber material proxies retained, including historical slab thickness.
Full-background run differs from the latest metal-off comparison and is not a new measurement fit.
Branches, petioles and soil remain visual-only; no cell mutual coupling or amplifier noise.
Support bench lowered to match the already-selected 0.50 m plant support hypothesis. This height is not confirmed by the experimenter.
Saved path display is a bounded subset on the scanner grid; maps use the complete coherent calculation.

support_geometry_hypothesis.reason: The fixed close-pair plants have pot bottoms at 0.5015 m. Their stems intersect the archived 0.75 m tabletop. This reversible hypothesis gives them a consistent support plane without moving plants, changing RIS states or fitting any measurement.
support_geometry_hypothesis.transform: Use archived level scanner/bench XY. Preserve upper section dimensions by lowering z > 0.72 m by 0.25 m. Shorten lower structure by z*0.47/0.72, feet remain at floor. RX sample plane retains its saved selected rotation independently.
support_geometry_hypothesis.status: Unconfirmed geometry assumption for presentation; original bench retained in environment_original_bench.npz.

coplanar_room_handling: Overlapping component triangles belonging to the same object/material/plane use their geometric union; each reflection point counted once.
